permissions.description: Incoming correspondence items and their handling

actions.description: Log a new correspondence item (physical or auto-captured)
Assign a newly logged item to a department
Reassign an item to a different department
Update the status of an item in the caller's department
Record a response for an item in the caller's department
Close an item in the caller's department once responded
Create, rename, deactivate departments, and configure their intake mailbox

permissions.description: User onboarding into departments and roles

actions.description: List onboarded users and their department/role
Assign a user to a department and role

groups.name: DepartmentOfficers
groups.description: Handle correspondence assigned to their department

roles.name: RegistryOfficer
roles.description: Logs incoming correspondence and routes it to the responsible department.

roles.name: DepartmentOfficer
roles.description: Works, responds to, and closes correspondence assigned to their department.

roles.name: Supervisor
roles.description: Monitors correspondence across departments and reassigns to rebalance workload.

roles.name: Admin
roles.description: Manages the department directory, its intake mailboxes, and onboards users.
